bridge-type.label: Net2 Server
bridge-type.description: Represents the Paxton Net2 Access Control Server

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: Net2 server hostname or IP address

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: HTTPS port of the Net2 Local API

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: Net2 API user (First Name Last Name format)

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: Net2 API license Client ID (from license file)

parameter.name: tlsVerification
parameter.label: TLS Verification
parameter.description: Verify the server's TLS certificate on the SignalR (live events) connection. The REST calls always verify against the Java trust store.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Seconds between door status polls (the safety net behind the live events)

parameter.name: autoReinstate
parameter.label: Auto Re-Instate
parameter.description: Re-instate an ACU by itself when it refuses known users (a Net2 fault that a Re-Instate cures). Off: the lockout channel still turns ON.

parameter.name: lockoutThreshold
parameter.label: Lockout Threshold
parameter.description: Refusals of known users at one door, with no entry between, that mean a lockout

parameter.name: lockoutWindow
parameter.label: Lockout Window
parameter.description: Minutes within which those refusals must fall

parameter.name: reinstateInterval
parameter.label: Re-Instate Interval
parameter.description: Least minutes between two automatic re-instates of the same ACU while the lockout lasts

parameter.name: name
parameter.label: Door Name
parameter.description: Not used: events name the door by the thing label

channel-type.label: Timed Door Control
channel-type.description: Activate door for a specified duration in seconds (e.g., send 1 to open for 1 second)

channel-type.label: Door Status
channel-type.description: The door relay as Net2 reports it (ON = released/open, OFF = locked)

channel-type.label: Last Access User
channel-type.description: The last user named by any event at the door - an entry or a refusal

channel-type.label: Create User
channel-type.description: Create user in Net2 system. Format: firstName,lastName,accessLevel,pin (e.g., John,Doe,3,1234)

channel-type.label: List Access Levels
channel-type.description: Trigger to list all available access levels; results logged to openhab.log

channel-type.label: List Users
channel-type.description: Trigger to list all users in the system; full JSON payload logged to openhab.log

channel-type.label: Entry Log
channel-type.description: JSON-formatted entry event, granted access only (event types 20 and 26): {"firstName":"John","lastName":"Doe","doorName":"Front Door","timestamp":"2026-01-10T18:04:01","doorId":1234567,"eventType":20,"eventSubType":0,"eventDescription":"Access permitted - token only"}

channel-type.label: Access Denied
channel-type.description: A token Net2 does not know (event type 23), as JSON: {"tokenNumber":"1234567","doorName":"Front Door","timestamp":"2026-01-16T17:09:14","doorId":1234567}. Known users who are refused are on accessEvent.

channel-type.label: Access Event
ACU Lockout
channel-type.description: ON when the ACU refuses known users (the bridge's lockoutThreshold refusals within lockoutWindow minutes, no entry between); OFF at the next entry.

channel-type.label: Last Re-Instate
channel-type.description: When the binding last sent a Re-Instate to this door's ACU

channel-type.label: Re-Instate ACU
channel-type.description: ON sends Net2's Re-Instate to the ACU of this door (it sends the ACU its configuration again). Cures an ACU that refuses every token and PIN. Falls back to OFF by itself.

channel-type.label: Lockdown
channel-type.description: Building lockdown control. Send ON to enable lockdown (lock all configured doors), OFF to disable (return to normal operation)

channel-type.label: Activity Report
channel-type.description: Generates an HTML activity report at /static/net2_activity.html on each refresh cycle. State shows last update timestamp.
